notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type.
description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.
